content: Rachel Morris, holding qualifications as a DHP (Diploma in Hypnotherapy and Psychotherapy) and MCAP (Member of the Counselling and Psychotherapy Association), is a British psychotherapist and counsellor based in Manchester, United Kingdom. She has contributed her expertise as a professional on various television programs, including Little Angels and Say No to the Knife on BBC Three. Additionally, she has appeared on Would Like to Meet, The Oprah Winfrey Show, Big Brother's Little Brother, and The Big Brother Psych Show. Her professional insights have also been featured on BBC Radio 1's Sunday Surgery. Beyond her media appearances, she serves as a consultant for Cosmopolitan magazine and contributes to the Relationships section of the BBC website.
